def run_shell(command: str, workdir: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    执行终端命令（执行前会显示命令并请求确认）。参数 command: 要执行的 shell 命令。返回命令输出。
    危险命令（rm -rf、format、mkfs 等）会被拦截。
    """
    dangerous = [
        "rm-never", "rm -fr", "rm -r -f", "rm -f -r",
        "mkfs", "format", "dd if=", ":(){", "chmod 777 /",
        "rd /s", "rmdir /s", "del /f", "remove-item",
        "shutdown", "reboot",
    ]
    cmd_lower = command.lower().replace(" ", "")
    for d in dangerous:
        if d.replace(" ", "") in cmd_lower:
            return f"[拦截] 命令 '{command}' 包含危险操作，已阻止执行"

def run_shell(command: str, workdir: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    执行终端命令（执行前会显示命令并请求确认）。参数 command: 要执行的 shell 命令。返回命令输出。
    危险命令（rm -rf、format、mkfs 等）会被拦截。
    """
    # Patterns compiled once; each is a regex that matches a dangerous command
    # regardless of whitespace, case, or argument order.
    _DANGEROUS_PATTERNS = [
        # --- destructive file removal (POSIX) ---
        re.compile(r"\brm\b.*\s*-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*\s+\.?/?\b"),          # rm -rf /
        re.compile(r"\brm\b\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\s+)*-r[a-zA-Z]*\b"),                  # rm -r (any flags)
        re.compile(r"\brm\b\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\s+)*-f[a-zA-Z]*\b"),                  # rm -f (any flags)
        re.compile(r"\bsudo\b.*\brm\b"),                                          # sudo rm ...
        # --- destructive file removal (Windows) ---
        re.compile(r"\brd\b\s+/[sS]\b"),                                         # rd /s
        re.compile(r"\brmdir\b\s+/[sS]\b"),                                      # rmdir /s
        re.compile(r"\bdel\b\s+/[fF]\b"),                                       # del /f
        re.compile(r"\bremove-item\b"),                                          # PowerShell Remove-Item
        # --- disk / partition destruction ---
        re.compile(r"\bmkfs\b"),                                                  # mkfs
        re.compile(r"\bformat\b\s+/[qQ]?\b"),                                    # format /q
        re.compile(r"\bdd\b\s+if="),                                             # dd if=
        # --- permission abuse ---
        re.compile(r"\bchmod\b\s+777\s+/"),                                      # chmod 777 /
        # --- fork bomb ---
        re.compile(r":\(\)\{\s*:\|:\s*;&"),                                     # :(){ :|:&;
        # --- system shutdown / reboot ---
        re.compile(r"\b(shutdown|reboot|poweroff|halt)\b"),                       # shutdown/reboot/poweroff/halt
    ]
    for pat in _DANGEROUS_PATTERNS:
        if pat.search(command):
            return f"[拦截] 命令 '{command}' 包含危险操作，已阻止执行"

import re

_DANGEROUS_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'\brm\b.*\s*-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*\s+\.?/?\b'),
    re.compile(r'\brm\b\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\s+)*-r[a-zA-Z]*\b'),
    re.compile(r'\brm\b\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\s+)*-f[a-zA-Z]*\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bsudo\b.*\brm\b'),
    re.compile(r'\brd\b\s+/[sS]\b'),
    re.compile(r'\brmdir\b\s+/[sS]\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bdel\b\s+/[fF]\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bremove-item\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bmkfs\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bformat\b\s+/[qQ]?\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bdd\b\s+if='),
    re.compile(r'\bchmod\b\s+777\s+/'),
    re.compile(r':\(\)\{\s*:\|:\s*;&'),
    re.compile(r'\b(shutdown|reboot|poweroff|halt)\b'),
]

# Test cases that SHOULD be blocked
blocked_cases = [
    'rm -rf /',
    'rm -r -f /tmp',
    'rm -fr /var',
    'rm -f -r /etc',
    'rm -rf /etc/passwd',
    'sudo rm -rf /',
    'RD /S C:\\Windows',
    'rmdir /s C:\\Temp',
    'del /f C:\\file.txt',
    'Remove-Item -Recurse -Force',
    'mkfs.ext4 /dev/sda',
    'format /q C:',
    'dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda',
    'chmod 777 /etc/shadow',
    ':(){ :|:& ;}',
    'shutdown -h now',
    'reboot',
    'poweroff',
    'halt',
]

# Test cases that should NOT be blocked (safe commands)
safe_cases = [
    'ls -la /home',
    'cat file.txt',
    'echo hello world',
    'git status',
    'npm install',
    'python script.py',
    'mkdir newdir',
    'touch file.txt',
    'cp source.txt dest.txt',
    'mv old.txt new.txt',
    'grep pattern file.txt',
    'find . -name *.py',
    'ps aux | grep python',
    'kill 1234',
    'vim edit.txt',
    'code .',
    'docker ps',
    'curl https://example.com',
    'ping 8.8.8.8',
    'ssh user@host',
]

print('=== Should be BLOCKED ===')
all_pass = True
for cmd in blocked_cases:
    matched = any(p.search(cmd) for p in _DANGEROUS_PATTERNS)
    status = 'PASS' if matched else 'FAIL'
    if not matched:
        all_pass = False
    print(f'  [{status}] {cmd}')

print()
print('=== Should be SAFE ===')
for cmd in safe_cases:
    matched = any(p.search(cmd) for p in _DANGEROUS_PATTERNS)
    status = 'PASS' if not matched else 'FAIL'
    if matched:
        all_pass = False
    print(f'  [{status}] {cmd}')

print()
if all_pass:
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
else:
    print('SOME TESTS FAILED')
